title: Measuring What VLMs Don’t Say: Validation Metrics Hide Clinical Terminology Erasure in Radiology Report Generation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper quantifies shifts in vocabulary-level associations between male and female patient groups in generated radiology reports. It uses novel metrics called Clinical Association Displacement (CAD) and Weighted Association Erasure (WAE) to measure the erasure of sex-specific clinical terms, the emergence of new sex-associated biases, and bias flips compared to human reference reports.
